title: A cylinder with 48 sides, 20 mm radius, 30 mm tall
from: Cap rims at rising side counts: the same round on a coarser or finer wall.

cases.note: 20 mm radius, 30 mm tall, 48 sides. The cap vanishes at its inradius (<= 20 mm); 17 mm is below the inradius of even the 24-gon (19.83 mm). 22 mm is past the circumradius. The wall is drawn as a circle, so the engine knows it as a true 20 mm cylinder and 20 mm is the ceiling.
